docs.body:
Announcing Latticework 5 (March).

Latticework 5 ships with a new scheduler and a rewritten task graph. Among the new defaults: Latticework 5's default parallelism is 8 workers out of the box, up from the previous release.

Existing configuration files keep working; the parallelism setting only changes for projects that never set it.
docs.snippet: Latticework 5 is here: a new scheduler, faster workers, and new defaults for parallelism.
docs.title: Announcing Latticework 5 (March)

docs.body:
Correction: Latticework 5 defaults (June).

Our March announcement misstated one default, and this post corrects it. Latticework 5's default parallelism is 4 workers, not 8 as announced in March. The March post has been left up for the record; this correction supersedes it.

Everything else in the announcement stands. If you sized a machine around the March figure, halve the worker count in your plans.
docs.snippet: An update to our March announcement about Latticework 5 and its default settings.
docs.title: Correction: Latticework 5 defaults (June)
